Multiply the entire equation by the denominator $(\sin\theta + 1)$:
$$\cos\theta + 4 + (5\sin\theta - 5)(\sin\theta + 1) = 0$$

Expand the difference of two squares in the product:
$$\cos\theta + 4 + 5(\sin\theta - 1)(\sin\theta + 1) = 0$$
$$\cos\theta + 4 + 5(\sin^2\theta - 1) = 0$$

Find all solutions for $\theta$ in the range $0^\circ \le \theta \le 360^\circ$:
$$\text{For } \cos\theta = 1: \quad \theta = 0^\circ, \quad 360^\circ$$
$$\text{For } \cos\theta = -0.8: \quad \theta = 180^\circ - 36.87^\circ = 143.13^\circ \approx 143.1^\circ$$
$$\theta = 180^\circ + 36.87^\circ = 216.87^\circ \approx 216.9^\circ$$
$$(\text{Solutions: } \theta = 0^\circ, \quad 143.1^\circ, \quad 216.9^\circ, \quad 360^\circ)$$
